text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Heavy track or not, it doesn't matter!!
Fix my eyes on the goal and just run my race!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond crosses the line first—!!
Not a speck of dirt on this finest diamond! An untarnished radiance!
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was phenomenal, Satono Diamond!!
To think you'd even beat McQueen!
Undisputed strength, pure and simple!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even smeared in mud, dignified and resolute.
...She was truly beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaahhhhh!!
Dammit, dammit, dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: My form and condition were both completely perfect, too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it just goes to show
how strong Dia-chan really is."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I still need to dedicate myself so much more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll work hard too,
so Kita-chan won't pass me by.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Satono-san, that was a splendid run.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san!
Thank you very much. But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The distance favored me today.
As a stayer, McQueen-san, longer distances are where you truly excel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But, after all,
I was the one who specified the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I-I would really love to see you
compete in Long distance races too!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to beat McQueen-san at long distance...!
That's a great attitude to have, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: In that case, how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A match with all of us together!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...!
B-By all means! Please do!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... You want to run too, don't you, Teio-san?
Against Satono-san, that is."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Tee-hee♪ Did you catch me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —The Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If that is what you all desire...
Then let us clash once more at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm running too!
Be sure to vote for me in the fan poll, okay?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? I'm definitely voting for you!
Teio, McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san...!
Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will be entering the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Me too!!
Looking forward to working with you!!
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

The roar of a crowd of sixty thousand shakes the stands.
This Arima Kinen promises to be the dream race of the century.

In the face of the rapturous cheers echoing across Tokyo Racecourse,
the option of not running in the Arima Kinen
simply did not exist.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Um, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: May I ask you one question?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san...
Why did you decide to run with us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing the race between the two of you lit a fire in me.
And I realized that, as a horse girl of the Mejiro family,
I must run.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What you want to hear about is how I carry myself these days, isn't it, Dia-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. McQueen-san is someone who has flourished
as the "renowned Umamusume" that the Satono family aspires to produce.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've come to realize that the reason she raced us this time
was perhaps because McQueen-san acted as a 'distinguished Umamusume'.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is quite correct.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—I have tasked myself with showing the Umamusume world
the enduring might of the Mejiro family
with a strength that leaves no room for doubt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the Tenno Sho (Spring) holds special meaning
for me and the Mejiro family... If a strong Umamusume
appears in this race, I must face her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is not all.
Beyond competing against Umamusume who have
proven track records in the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To take on the challenge of newly emerging
Umamusume like Satono-san and the others,
demonstrate overwhelming strength, and claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And so—the Mejiro family name would continue to resonate far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is the way I choose to live right now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: To continue upholding the strength of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the Satono and Mejiro families
stand in very different positions."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The history of the Satono family in the Umamusume world essentially begins with Dia-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So Dia-san,
you must have a path that's different from mine."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...The history of the Satono family begins with me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, McQueen-san.
I will think about it in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
May light guide your path, Dia-san.
Farewell for now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...McQueen-san really is wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To possess such an unwavering purpose
as an "eminent Umamusume"...
I truly admire her...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Just as you said, McQueen-san,
I've been thinking about what my own way of being should be...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I want to give
McQueen-san my answer at the Arima Kinen!"

The "Arima Kinen"—it seems Satono Diamond's dream
of becoming a "legendary Umamusume" will find
its answer there.
